data.plainLyric:
Oh, Hannah, you're always on my mind
Taming horses in the wild
And we still don't talk after all this time

Oh, Hannah, I, I just don't know why
But I still hide from you and I
Come spring, come summer, I just stay inside

And it's been so long, but I still recall
How I heard you crying through the wall
And I didn't ask you what went wrong
You just changed your hair, and we all moved on

Oh, how I miss you, Hannah Montana
Down in the valley, Hannah Montana
Can you hear me as I call? (Oh)

Oh, Hannah, you're in therapy enough
I think it's time you fell in love
I wish I was brave when it was just us (oh)

Dear other child, so many names
I don't know why I never came
To see you when I moved away

And it's been so long, but I still recall
How I heard you crying through the wall
And when you changed into someone else
No, I never asked you how it felt

Oh, how I miss you, Hannah Montana
Down in the valley, Hannah Montana
Alone in the backseat, Hannah Montana
I never answered when you called
Hannah Montana
